paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Informativeness and missing step values of 4 representative LLMs
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the missing step values for four large language models (LLMs) across a sequence of iterations. The x-axis represents the number of iterations, ranging from 0 to 4, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 1. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step Step," utilizes a linear scale and spans from approximately 0.833 to 0.850, with units of “Step.” The blue dashed line, representing 0-CoT, begins at a value of approximately 0.850 and decreases linearly to roughly 0.835 by the end of the x-axis. A orange solid line, representing Core, starts at approximately 0.840 and decreases to approximately 0.830 by the end of the x-axis. A red solid line, representing CoRe, begins at approximately 0.840 and decreases to approximately 0.830 by the end of the x-axis.
